QUOTE: `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.json` | A `path` row, so the file is in the file set and findable by name ... | Any symbols. Their grammar nodes (`block_mapping_pair`, `pair`) are deliberately not written as `memberdef`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states YAML/JSON get only path rows (in the file set) with no symbols, contrasted with shell/CMake which carry definitions.
